items.question: What elevation defines the protrusion measured from the northern projection?
premises: The protrusion belongs to the projection.
The measurement is taken from the northern side.
The specified feature is an elevated height.
items.inference: The protrusion of the projection is defined as the height raised from the northern projection.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referent of vājana in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: But the protrusion of the projection is the height raised from the northern projection.
